name: Medical Device Manufacturing
old_description: At Tii-Medical, we are inspired by our customers' cutting-edge designs and are committed to sharing our 22 years of tribal knowledge in manufacturing surgical instruments to help streamline manufacturing processes, reduce costs, and improve delivery times as a value-added service. With our vertically integrated capabilities allow us to manufacture most surgical instruments from start to finish in-house, ensuring high quality and efficiency. Our services include: 7-axis Swiss Machining, CNC-Machining, Assembly, Heat Treat, Passivation(A967) & Laser Marking.
about:
Tii-Medical is based in Three Rivers, Massachusetts. The company operates as a medical device manufacturer specializing in surgical instruments.

The shop provides a vertically integrated suite of services including 7-axis Swiss machining on Tsugami equipment with 1-inch bar capacity, 3-, 4-, and 5-axis CNC machining, assembly, heat treating, passivation per A967, and laser marking. In-house additive manufacturing covers both Stratasys F370 FDM and J55 Polyjet systems, while reverse engineering and 3D scanning with Artec scanners support design iteration and proof-of-concept work. Additional offerings include SolidWorks design support, manufacturing logistics, and full proof-of-concept development.

Tii-Medical serves the medical device and medical manufacturing sectors, with a focus on surgical instrument producers and companies developing body-scanning applications for healthcare. Customers range from established OEMs to early-stage innovators seeking to streamline production of complex, high-precision components.

The company emphasizes its 22 years of tribal knowledge in surgical instrument manufacturing as a differentiator, promoting vertically integrated, start-to-finish production under one roof to reduce lead times and costs. ISO 13485 certification underscores its quality management commitment for regulated medical markets.
